title: Where and What to Reward? Understanding Generalization Between Verifiable and Open-Ended Domains in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.15464v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve the reasoning capability of language models, since model-generated answers can be easily verified by a rule-based verifier. In contrast, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is mainly used to optimize open-ended conversation with a learned reward model, because such responses are not easy to verify. RLVR and RLHF are usually trained separately with their own domain data and training protocols. How gains transfer between these domains is unclear, partly because comparisons change both where a model is trained (the prompts) and what is rewarded (by a verifier or a reward model). translated_title: 在何处奖励、奖励什么？理解强化学习中可验证领域与开放式领域之间的泛化
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被广泛用于提升语言模型的推理能力，因为模型生成的答案可以很容易地通过基于规则的验证器进行验证。相比之下，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）主要用于优化开放式对话，它依赖学习到的奖励模型，因为这类回复不容易验证。RLVR 和 RLHF 通常使用各自领域的数据和训练协议分开训练。这些领域之间的增益如何迁移尚不清楚，部分原因在于以往的比较往往同时改变了模型训练的位置（提示词）和奖励的对象（通过验证器或奖励模型）。我们在一项受控研究中将这两个因素分离开来，在多个基础模型上进行强化学习实验，固定优化器和训练提示词的数量，仅改变提示词的来源领域（数学、多领域、聊天或混合）和奖励类型。我们发现开放式……
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验分离“提示词来源领域”与“奖励类型”这两个因素，系统揭示了RLVR与RLHF在可验证推理任务与开放式对话任务之间的泛化与迁移规律。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments that disentangle prompt-source domains from reward types, this study reveals how RL gains generalize and transfer between verifiable reasoning tasks and open-ended conversation tasks.
